cros-kernel2.eclass: Skip Image.gz creation for arm64 On arm64 kernels we compress the kernel in this eclass (see _cros-kernel2_compress_fit_kernel() for more info). The default target of the kernel build compresses the kernel with gzip, and that just wastes some time during the build. Only build the Image and dtbs targets so we can avoid this small overhead. shill: simplify dependency injection to DeviceInfo DeviceInfo depends on EventDispatcher, Metrics, and Manager. These dependencies are currently injected via the constructor of DeviceInfo. The same applies to all DeviceInfo subclasses. Manager also depends on EventDispatcher, and Metrics, which can conveniently serve as a "context object" for injecting and forwarding these dependencies to DeviceInfo. While explicit dependency injection is generally preferred as it avoids obscure or unnecessary coupling of dependencies, in case of DeviceInfo, forwarding additional dependencies via Manager substantially simplifies the code structure and also avoids DeviceInfo and Manager from using different dependencies in tests, which could lead to mismatches between the production environment and the test environment. BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests. Change-Id: Ia8e265cdb532c91a3420bbeb1c51b11b5e91b6f0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1650098 Commit-Ready: Ben Chan <benchan@chromium.org> Tested-by: Ben Chan <benchan@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hugo Benichi <hugobenichi@google.com>
